notes.content: Fixed a bug that occurred when saving a game with a low HP. for Example, when a player is starving and has a low HP, he presses save. Then he dies and continues the game. After that, the game was buggy.

notes.title: Fixed bugs. Added a hotkey. Optimized the game.
notes.content:
1. Inventory errors were fixed in the game (there were problems with guns, when they were moved from quick access to the satchel - cartridges were added), this error appeared after the last update.
2. Now the game has a hot key for opening and closing of the container. To do this, press the "TAB"key.
3. The game was further optimized by removing duplicate materials. This optimization reduces the load on the video core.

notes.title: You have the opportunity to help find errors!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32200705/eb24cefd486053676edc43859579a8d49b3408ec.jpg[/img]
The game has added the ability to view the developer console. Now in case of an error (red exclamation mark), you can understand that a critical error occurred in the game. To activate the console, you need to go to settings in the main menu and click "Console". During red errors, click on it and copy it, or take a screenshot and send it to the community.
I will be very grateful to anyone who can help us detect such bugs in the game!

Other updates in the game:
1. Skins for wood and metal armor have been updated;
2. The system for selecting new weapons was slightly changed.

Note:
The game will soon be ported to the mobile platform.

notes.title: More loyal generation of the world! New algorithm for saving gameplay!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32200705/e47e6fe12a44d3a18e8d6f5bfdb2f5ce2f06a158.jpg[/img]

1. The game will now have a more loyal generation of the game world. Now it will be easier to start a new game! On the first location will not spawn animals, and rare mobs (fat man, spitting poison, etc.). Also, the first location will no longer spawn a car with an active alarm system. And now the first location will never be a "swamp".
2. New game saving system! Previously, the game process was saved automatically when the player enters the base. This could harm the player, since he does not always return to the base full, and this killed him, and as a result, the player continued the game with a "dead loop". But now, the game is saved manually. Now the player just needs to click on the virtual button (on the interface) to save, at any time they need. The main condition to make a save-the player must be on the base.

notes.title: Added a new weapon - a flamethrower. As well as other improvements!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32200705/bc7e0970966bfe8ae2031031a895df42629c48ad.gif[/img]

1. A new weapon has been added to the game - a flamethrower. It is able to massively fry up a bunch of zombies!
2. The ability to create fuel for a flamethrower was added to the crafting section (located at the workbench). This requires only one ingredient - a Molotov cocktail.
3. Was fixed a glitch in the animation of the character (was incorrectly detected transitions animations)
4. The program code of the player training section has been updated.

In the near future, we plan to make an "easy start" for the player, that is, not to generate dangerous zombies and difficult obstacles at the first location.

To create cartridges, it is enough to have at least two gunpowder in the satchel.

notes.title: Fixed a problem with a quick restart of the game
notes.content:
[list]
[*] After the player's death, the player could quickly start the level again. But this could cause a number of problems, and also did not give the player at the beginning of the game (near the base) some items to start the game. 
[*] There was also a problem that a new player entering the game could click "Continue" the game, and this also did not work well enough!
[/list]
But now these problems have been fixed! I wish you all a good game! ːLike_Yellowː

notes.title: New trailer! New changes in the game!
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xHBTXqN3TLI

Changes to the game:
- Fixed inventory issues.
- Implemented randomly generated "taxi", which allows the player to move once (instantly) to the base.
- Added 3 face masks that give certain bonuses to the player!
- Added 3 types of armor, in order to reduce the damage received from the zombie attacks!
- Implemented interface to visualize the remaining strength of the armor.
- Fixed a bug with the fire of the player.
- Added in the generation, where the player can "dig", and get a few useful items! (And can and not will find).
- Added a boat for which the player will look for spare parts to sail it to the rest of the survivors. If you find spare parts, then he doesn't have to be in the game for 30 days. It's an alternate ending, so to speak. Objects, logic and interface are implemented.
- Created a beautiful trailer showing the background of the game
- Added hints for the player in the survival book
- Added achievements to the survival book
- Implemented a system of remuneration for achievement.
- Added the ability to view information about the item in the inventory.
- Added" Non-walking " zombies that can't move. Are killed with one strike / shot being fired. And inflict damage if is near with them.

In addition, the game had a lot of other changes, which are now no longer remembered) The project is in active development) View additional trailer, which will show the background of the game: Like_Yellow:

notes.title: New changes to the game
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32200705/efd886f4a56d843013c0bd74ba051aadceb3ba1c.jpg[/img]
Hello dears! The game continues to improve and be saturated with a variety of content! : Two_Fingers:
Here are some of the changes that took place in this game:
1. Came the sound of walking/running the character and zombies!
2. Added information graphic signs when entering the location (it will be written on what location you are).
3. An additional block of code was added, which insures the generation of the game world from unexpected errors.
4. Was corrected instantaneous travel through the sewers.
5. Added graphic icons for items that you can pick up!
6. Implemented transparency items that prevent the camera to see the main character (for example, when the player is a big car).
7 . Just been fixed a lot of small bugs.

Note: we need enthusiastic translators to translate the game from Russian into English and Chinese.
